dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: These plants are growing superbly. And you can tell they're in a great mood.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: You're really good at taking care of your friends.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Of course, if you ever find they get upset, just let me know. I'll be more than happy to come cheer them up for you.
